title: PostHog auto-fix result
description: What the fixer agent concluded about one PostHog issue. Mirrors AgentResult in api/crates/admin/src/posthog_autofix/model.rs.

outcome.description: fixed_with_test and fixed_without_test are the only outcomes with commits.

target_repo.description: The one repository the commits are in; null without a fix.

summary.description: One short sentence: what goes wrong for the user and on which route (page route or API route), e.g. `Print fails on /employee/quote/:quoteId when the old preview window is still open`.

given.description: The precondition or state, without the word `Given`, e.g. `a company with calling turned off`.

when.description: The user's action that leads to the error, naming the page route and the API route when there is one, without the word `When`, e.g. `a user opens any /employee page and the phone dock calls POST /v1/phone/web/devices`.

then.description: What the system does at that point (the response or event that triggers the error), without the word `Then`, e.g. `the API answers 403 calling_disabled`.

impact.description: One short sentence on what users notice, or that they notice nothing, e.g. `Users see nothing; PostHog noise only.` No counts: the api adds the event and user counts itself.

root_cause.description: Why it happens, with file paths and line references.

fix_summary.description: One or two short sentences: what the fix adds or changes, naming the new function, variable or check and its file, e.g. `Adds isPlaceholderImage() in StoneImageCropInput.tsx and skips the editor for placeholder images`. Empty string without a fix.

risk.description: What the fix could break and how likely that is. Empty string without a fix.

status.description: written: a test in the first commit reproduces the bug. not_possible: a fix without a test. not_applicable: no fix.

files.description: Test files, relative to the target repository.

command.description: Exactly `bunx vitest run <test files>` or `cargo test -p <crate> [--test <target>] <filter>` (an `api/tests/<area>/<file>.rs` test: `cargo test -p api --test <area> <file>::<test name>`). null without a test.

why_not_possible.description: Why no automated test can reproduce the bug. null when a test was written.

manual_test_steps.description: Numbered steps a reviewer follows to see the fix in the app. Give them for every fix; required when status is not_possible.

check.description: One line: how a developer sees the fix by hand, building on Given/When, e.g. `Repeat Given/When → no calling_disabled error in PostHog.` Empty string without a fix.

recommendation.description: The concrete next step for a person when there is no fix: a migration to apply, a PostHog suppression or grouping rule, a setting to change.

duplicate_of.description: The pull request URL or commit SHA that already covers this issue (outcome duplicate).

pr_title.description: Conventional-commit style pull request title, e.g. `fix(sms): handle an empty CloudTalk reply`. null without a fix.
